subject: Record the Pane specification and plan, and track the work in GitHub Issues
body:
Adds the Pane specification, the cross-platform plan and the extension
runtime research, then publishes the first tickets and moves planning
to GitHub Issues.
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Run the first Rust and JS/TS commands in Pane's native window
body:
Runs one Rust command in Pane's native window, validates the JS/TS
WASI 0.3 backend and runs JS and TS versions of the sample command.
Applies the licensing split and DCO, and records native Linux, macOS
and Windows baselines with CI evidence.

PRs: #2, #3, #5, #6, #7, #8
author: wasimysaid <wasimysdev@gmail.com>

subject: Install local extension packages and show their forms and custom views
body:
Installs and runs a local extension package, submits and validates
native forms, declares platform availability and keeps the selected row
in view. Disabling an extension keeps its settings, and a custom view
can choose a color.

PRs: #9, #10, #19, #20, #21
author: wasimysaid <wasimysdev@gmail.com>

subject: Find commands, calculator answers and quicklinks in root search
body:
Typing in root search finds and invokes commands, shows a calculator
result and opens persistent URL quicklinks. Extensions can call the
operations another installed extension publishes.

PRs: #22, #23, #27, #28
author: wasimysaid <wasimysdev@gmail.com>

subject: Find applications, open commands by global hotkey and manage the extension lifecycle
body:
Root search finds and opens installed applications, and a global hotkey
opens an extension command on Windows, macOS and Linux (X11 grabs,
raised window). Extensions can be reloaded and their cache cleared,
pending calls stop on disable or reload, and uninstall asks what to do
with saved data.

PRs: #11, #14, #24, #25, #26, #32, #33, #34, #39, #40
author: wasimysaid <wasimysdev@gmail.com>

subject: Develop local packages with reload on save, and manage dependencies
body:
Development mode builds, stages and reloads a local package on save,
kills its processes and watches folders by identity. Extensions that
cannot start are paused with Retry, retained data can be deleted, and
commands run through aliases and fallbacks. Required dependencies and
packaged native helpers install, and dependents disable together.

PRs: #12, #13, #15, #16, #31, #41, #42, #43
author: wasimysaid <wasimysdev@gmail.com>

subject: Keep Pane responsive when a guest crashes or hangs, and search files and the web
body:
Pane stays usable when its runtime thread crashes, and a watchdog stops
unresponsive guests and stuck runtime threads, counting only a guest's
own computing. Dependents uninstall together, and commands can find
files in a chosen folder and search an online service.

PRs: #17, #18, #29, #30, #44
author: wasimysaid <wasimysdev@gmail.com>

subject: Install extensions from npm and Git, and keep opt-in clipboard history
body:
Extension packages install from npm and Git repositories. Clipboard
history is opt-in, watched on Windows, expires and can be deleted. The
watchdog charges no web response or nested host call to a guest and is
bounded by the thread's own time.

PRs: #18, #35, #36, #45, #46
author: wasimysaid <wasimysdev@gmail.com>

subject: Install Pane on every platform and run extension tasks and services
body:
Pane installs on Linux, Windows and macOS and acquires its default
extensions. Extensions can run scheduled tasks and continuing services
that stop on disable, and clipboard history is watched on Linux and
macOS too.

PRs: #37, #38, #47, #48, #51, #52, #53
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Offer Pane and extension updates on every platform
body:
Pane offers application updates by user choice on Windows, Linux and
macOS. npm extensions update at a safe boundary, and tracked Git
extensions update without changing identity.

PRs: #49, #50, #54, #55, #56
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Measure resource use and choose the release's default extensions
body:
Measures Pane's per-platform resource use and sets its targets, steadies
the smokes, keeps the launcher's Developing Arc so automatic updates run,
and makes calculator, applications, quicklinks, files and clipboard
history the release's defaults.

PRs: #4, #58, #59, #60
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Integrate the launcher UI on the maintained GPUI CE fork
body:
Separates launcher presentation ownership, pins the maintained GPUI CE
fork with renderer regressions in CI, and applies shared dark and light
visuals with a bounded status footer. Records the Windows glass
evidence, centralizes smoke color roles and rounds the Windows window.

PRs: #61, #62, #63, #64
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Open an independent Settings window and add command transitions
body:
Records the Settings and motion research, replaces the footer hints
with the selected primary action, opens Settings in its own window and
adds subtle command open and back transitions. Adds a fast CI tier for
milestone worktrees.

PRs: #70, #71, #72, #86
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Fill the Settings pages for shortcuts, appearance, extensions and General
body:
Settings can browse commands and edit aliases, change and persist the
appearance, manage extensions, record the Open Pane hotkey, choose
launch at login and search its pages. The release matrix runs on main
only, and the CI tiers are documented.

PRs: #73, #74, #75, #80, #81, #83
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Finish the Settings pages and the shared motion policy
body:
Adds section and group transitions, the About page's updates and
diagnostics, the Launcher page's placement choices, Keyboard page
rebinding, the tray or menu-bar entry, command hotkey recording, the
searchable select and the popup, hover and press micro-transitions.

PRs: #76, #77, #78, #79, #82, #85, #87, #88
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Port the launcher and Settings to the reference design
body:
Sets up a Windows reference/native comparison workbench, then matches
the 760x518 frame, keycaps, tiles, root rows, footer and Actions panel,
the Settings shell, no-results card, clipboard split view, pinned home,
Appearance controls and shared controls, and records the acceptance
evidence.

PRs: #91, #92, #93, #94, #95, #96, #97, #98, #99, #101, #102, #103
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Redesign the launcher and Settings in the Raycast style
body:
Checks in the UI port's research, draws glyphs from the vendored reicon
set and ports the launcher and Settings window to the Raycast-style
redesign. Adds a user-chosen background image that lets the frost show
through, quicker view arrival, keyboard opens that land at once and
controls that press on pointer-down.
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Bring docs and tests in line with the redesign and deepen the core modules
body:
Updates the docs and glossary, stops CI retries landing as commits,
deepens pane-core's launcher, downloads and test support, gives host
settings one commit path with rollback, separates window presence from
LauncherWindow, covers the redesign with window tests and builds each
crate's integration tests as one binary.

PRs: #106, #109, #110, #111, #112, #113, #118
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Give extension commands the full command model
body:
Serves other extensions' calls while one waits, caps guest memory at
128 MiB, carries lists through a typed envelope with several actions per
item, runs no-view commands, and adds icons, accessories, submenus,
toasts, host functions, preferences, arguments and system programs.

PRs: #120, #134, #135, #136, #160
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Complete default extensions, application discovery and indexed file search
body:
Gives applications stable identities, discovery, watching, localized
names and icons; indexes the home folder with Pane's own engine and a
Raycast-like Search Files; keeps images and files in clipboard history;
manages extensions per page in Settings and draws only visible rows.

PRs: #161-#176, #178, #179, #180, #181
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Move to pane-app/pane and record how extensions are sourced and built
body:
Points live references at pane-app/pane after the repository moved, and
records where extensions come from, how their API changes and how
people build them.

PRs: #209, #210, #211
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Keep extension logs and make the SDKs and build tooling publishable
body:
Keeps each extension's log and shows it on a Logs screen, builds the
patched componentizer in CI for every platform, moves development
builds into a shared build crate and makes the SDKs publishable as
pane-extension and @pane-app/extension. Records the Raycast research.

PRs: #119, #212, #213, #215, #216, #220, #227, #228
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Add pane-ext dev and the local channel, and land the quick fixes
body:
pane-ext dev drives the running Pane over a local channel, with its
failures in the log. The quick fixes bring the tray icon back after
Explorer restarts, protect local secrets with DPAPI, announce the
selected row, and keep a redacted log that reports unexpected quits.

PRs: #129, #130, #131, #132, #133, #182, #217, #257, #271, #272
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Meet the file-index and idle-cost targets and record the evidence
body:
File queries answer within 10 ms at p95, changes re-index within 10 ms
and 10,000 changes catch up within 1 s. While hidden, Pane re-extracts
icons only when needed, lets its runtime timers sleep and shares
clipboard history with its view. Records the measurements.

PRs: #126, #183-#192, #273, #274, #275, #277, #288
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Install the official extensions from pinned repositories
body:
First setup installs the default extensions from the commits this
release pins, Settings marks them official, and their sources leave
Pane's repository with samples kept as fixtures. Smokes serve the
pinned repositories locally.

PRs: #207, #278, #280, #282, #284, #285, #286, #291, #296, #297
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Check for extension updates on demand and record their results
body:
Records update results, shows them and announces background failures,
checks for extension updates on demand and updates all, and updates
default extensions from their repositories' release tags.

PRs: #127, #256, #267, #269, #293, #298
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Add Windows power features: paste, Run, System Commands, Switch Windows and game mode
body:
Pastes into the front application, adds Run with Win+R history, System
Commands, Switch Windows and reading the selected text, falls back to a
keyboard hook, binds modifier taps and the Windows key alone, and adds
game mode. Fixes the release matrix after the merge and records the
redesign's final state.

PRs: #105, #125, #252-#255, #259-#266, #268, #292, #306, #315
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Complete extension authoring: check, pack, templates and the CLI
body:
Adds a crash overlay with the stack trace, the pane.json schema and
pane-ext check, JS/TS builds in pane-build, pane-ext pack, pane-ext as
@pane-app/cli, templates with pane-ext new and npm create @pane-app,
and Create Extension and Import Extension in Pane.

PRs: #128, #214, #218, #219, #221, #222, #223, #224, #225, #290
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Polish the launcher's text, toasts, HUD, selection and native materials
body:
Sets text levels by alpha with contrast floors, draws named glyphs on a
neutral tile, shows outcomes as toasts and a HUD, refines the selection
wash and loading bar, fires chords only on exact modifiers, backs out
with Backspace, and picks macOS vibrancy and an opaque Linux launcher.

PRs: #66, #67, #123, #245-#251, #258, #289, #313
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Rank root search like Raycast, with fuzzy matching, learning and inline arguments
body:
Matches fuzzily and without accents, understands addresses and paths,
ranks with Raycast's comparator and keywords, publishes within 200 ms,
browses typed folders, learns from choices with a reset, holds keys
until the list is published, and adds inline arguments and recent
queries.

PRs: #122, #193-#206, #295, #322
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Let extensions provide and use capabilities and register items at run time
body:
Packages provide and use named capabilities routed through Pane, with
the provider chosen in Settings, shown in the install preview and in
Manage extensions. Extensions register root items, timers, watchers
and providers at run time and hand state to new code on reload.

PRs: #151-#158, #276
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Pin the Windows default extensions and gate defaults by platform
body:
Pins the Windows defaults in defaults.json gated by platform, serves
their repositories in tests, exercises them in the smokes and moves
their builds out of Pane's repository.

PRs: #300, #302, #303, #304, #305, #314
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Install, update and develop extensions from collections
body:
Installs one, some or all of a collection's extensions, updates them
from their own release tags, develops one from a collection folder,
follows renamed ids and fetches only the chosen folders. Fixes the tests
the removal of the five extensions left behind.

PRs: #198, #307-#312, #316, #323, #324
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Draw extension views as a designed tree of layout primitives
body:
Extension views become a tree of layout primitives with shared
components and tokens, a navigation stack, timed and pushed re-renders,
state kept by key, and List, Detail, Grid, canvas and Form rebuilt on
it. Fixes the accumulated release matrix's first two waves.

PRs: #121, #235-#243, #294, #326, #327
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Version the extension API and ship 0.2 beside an adapter for 0.1
body:
Makes the WIT package's version the extension API number, fails lints
on incompatible changes without a new version, refuses extensions built
for versions Pane cannot run, ships API 0.2 with an adapter for 0.1 and
records breaking changes in the release notes.

PRs: #208, #317-#321, #325
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Fix the release matrix after the designed views and API 0.2 landed
body:
Moves the samples to API 0.2, fixes the WIT guard, the keycap parse and
JS form children, retires the typed-form templates, and fixes the
search event's self-deadlock, the search field's keyboard and the
Switch Windows view. Folds in matrix fix-forwards 4-10.

PRs: #328-#334
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Restore designed views' focus and deliver their events and web answers
body:
Restores the window's focus ask, traces designed events through the
park, pump and wasi:http boundary, fixes the search samples' service
preference and the Rust SDK's text styles, and makes the tests wait for
designed answers. Folds in matrix fix-forwards 11-21.

PRs: #335-#345
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Re-render designed views on every query and mint the Rust SDK's callback ids
body:
Treats the cleared listing as the empty state, drops a pending answer
with its text, mints callback ids in the Rust SDK's views and gives the
test twin the changes channel the real window has. Folds in matrix
fix-forwards 22-37 and their diagnostics.

PRs: #346-#361
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Answer designed-view events before async work and settle the smoke faces
body:
The JS SDK answers designed-view events before async work and TSX nodes
carry keys, search samples clear stale rows, and the smokes read toasts
within their three seconds and log their own key injections. Folds in
matrix fix-forwards 38-48 and parallel fixes 1-2.

PRs: #362-#374
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Let a newer search supersede in-flight work and keep guest calls served across a park
body:
Holds the park's wake registration, aborts a superseded search's web
requests after the turn, puts the guest's calls back when the instance
survives a park, and makes the operations samples call greet at its
version.

PRs: #375-#380
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Migrate the tests to state-reading waits and fix the dependencies fixtures
body:
Moves the settle family to state-reading waits, declares the form
commands the dependencies fixtures launch, stops the services thread
when the launcher drops, and delivers every event a render raised with
search events in query order.

PRs: #381-#391
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Let only a search supersede a view's work, and fix designed toasts, templates and canvases
body:
Only a search event supersedes a view's work in flight; toast details
keep their focus, the form template scaffolds again, a canvas without a
role draws and a key-asking canvas gets navigation keys, and held keys
settle their typing.

PRs: #392-#398
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Fix the pane-core census: command screens, form keys, reloads and updates
body:
Keyboard focus returns only when a designed view closes, form fields
are keyed, designed fields keep Backspace and submit only on Enter, and
the census tranches fix canvas limits, late opens, Switch Windows,
reloads, the update trio, recovery tests and the handoff samples.

PRs: #399-#408
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Finish the designed-era migration and remove the spent diagnostics
body:
Joins designed keys as bindings spell them, keeps a designed List's
typed-ahead text, fixes the registrations roots, measures text-only
canvases, colours the operations answer by outcome and removes the
diagnostic scaffolds.

PRs: #409-#414
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Bring the GUI smokes back to green and pin the defaults for extension API 0.2
body:
Lets Pane's keyboard hook run while Pane is in front, tells assistive
technology a hotkey's route, refuses root providers of another API
shape, pins the defaults for API 0.2, pastes into elevated applications
after the target settles, and brings the GUI smokes back to green.

PRs: #415-#420, #422, #423, #425
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: List the official extensions at first setup and steady the real-input tests
body:
First setup lists the official extensions with the defaults ticked, a
failed Pane update's row is selected again, the macOS icon worker is
throttled correctly, and the real-input hung-target and selection tests
run on CI again.

PRs: #426-#431
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Hide the macOS launcher's window controls and fix the remaining test races
body:
Keeps a filtered list row's icon, hides the macOS launcher's window
buttons and hides it on close, reads the selection by UI Automation,
gives the Windows real-input tests native targets, and fixes the file
index, services and timers races.

PRs: #436, #437, #438, #440, #441, #442, #443
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Publish the SDKs, archive the old notes and rewrite the README and docs
body:
The SDKs are published on crates.io and npm and the defaults are pinned
to releases built from them. Old evidence, handoff and research notes
move to an archive tag, the README is short and shows the launcher, and
the human-facing docs are rewritten.

PRs: #444-#450
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Release Pane through GitHub with app icons, version info and license notices
body:
Gives the packages an app icon, version info and license notices,
keeps Pane.app's Info.plist version current after an update, updates
Pane from GitHub Releases and drafts a prerelease when a version tag is
pushed.

PRs: #452, #453, #454, #457, #459, #460, #461
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Install Pane from a setup .exe, .dmg or AppImage, and keep the launcher off the taskbar
body:
Keeps the launcher off the taskbar and Alt+Tab, installs Pane on
Windows with a setup .exe, and on macOS from a .dmg and Linux from an
AppImage.

PRs: #458, #462, #463, #464, #465, #473
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Polish the launcher for Pane 0.1.0
body:
Arrow keys move a designed List's selection again, first setup shows
the official extensions' icons, the Windows-key tap works beside
key-masking tools and every hotkey press toggles the launcher, the
answer card is labelled and typeset, pushed views get a back button,
and opening an app, file or link closes the launcher.

PRs: #466-#472, #474, #476-#481
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Pin the calculator that converts currencies
body:
Moves the calculator's pin to v0.6.4, which converts currencies.

PRs: #475, #484
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Give pushed views without a search bar a top bar with a back button
body:
A pushed view with no search bar now shows a top bar with a back
button.

PRs: #482, #485
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>

subject: Move Pane to version 0.1.1
body:
The first point release after v0.1.0, so the in-app updater can be
tried going from 0.1.0 to 0.1.1.

PRs: #483
author: hoangvu12 <hggaming91@gmail.com>
